Sascha confused people very often, because they didn’t present themselves as either a woman or a man.

* Proto-Indo-European *seǵʰ- (“related to overpowering”), so called after the force of the water, one gush overtaking the other, then cognate to the Schüß / Schüss / Suze f in Bern, Sionge…
